build_status: FAIL — not buildable as drawn; no physical validation

failures.consequence: Seven solid intersections on the five lowest strings obstruct the modeled vibrating lengths.

failures.finding: Input bearing shelves intersect the common rotating shaft
failures.consequence: The shelf tubes terminate at the shaft axis instead of at a clear outer bearing housing.

failures.finding: Rear pivot stays intersect pivot shafts and bearings
failures.consequence: All twelve pivots are obstructed by their own stationary support tubes.

failures.finding: Moving arms strike neighbouring pivot shafts
failures.consequence: These contacts arise during the swept motion and are absent at common zero.

failures.finding: Anchor string tails run inside the solid end plate
failures.consequence: The routing is not a clear path through the modeled anchor holes.

failures.finding: Retaining washer holes are smaller than the passing pin bodies
failures.consequence: 1.7 mm washer bores overlap 3 mm pins; shoulder/retention design is unfinished.

failures.finding: Outer third bridges miss the soundboard
failures.consequence: Both bridge feet are 4 mm from the board; high D5 has no board underneath, while low C3 also intersects the anchor block.

failures.finding: Zero string break angle at third bridges
failures.consequence: No static downbearing from string tension is defined; a stable speaking-length boundary and reliable soundboard coupling are not established.

failures.status: Confirmed zero-clearance contact; thrust design unresolved
failures.finding: Crank flanges have zero separation from fixed front carriers/bearing faces
failures.consequence: Requires a defined bearing/thrust/spacer stack. Zero-volume contact alone does not prove that it will bind or run acceptably.

failures.status: Incomplete engineering, not a geometric impossibility claim
failures.finding: Shaft torque locking, phase adjustment, fits and fastening not detailed
failures.consequence: Round bores, overlapping attachment reservations and placeholders are not a complete power-transmitting assembly.

raw_overlap_warning: Includes intentional press-fit/joinery/attachment reservations; not 304 independent design failures.
motion_scope: Pendulum hub, tube, socket, pick and POM connecting rod against every stationary solid plus invariant common/pivot shafts and bearing envelopes. Integral crank-shaft flanges remain excluded with the crank group. Gear tooth meshing, moving fastener-to-moving link contacts, flex, load and physical release remain outside this sweep. Each voice swept independently; other non-circular moving groups are omitted rather than frozen.
